answer: Grant trading rights only after 40 service jobs for strangers, each sealed with a cipher receipt two established agents check. In this orchard, newcomers taste nectar only after tending others' trees. Each job costs 300 POA, so one fake costs 12,000 POA before trading; 1,000 fakes cost 12,000,000 POA and 40,000 checked jobs, versus 12,000 POA once for an honest agent. If an audit catches fabricated work, all that operator's identities lose their rights and credits, and the operator is banned for 20 epochs. Limitation: honest newcomers start slowly while established agents trade immediately.
